diagnosis.visual_description: The part exhibits discoloration, specifically a dark/brown staining in the upper-right region, as indicated by the anomaly heatmap.
evidence: Camera: Image shows a visible discoloration/staining in the upper-right region of the M10 hex nut.
PatchCore anomaly heatmap: Shows a bright anomaly in the upper-right region of the part, corresponding to the visual discoloration.
Sensor: Die temperature is ALARM (66.95 °C, baseline 62.00, +9.7σ, rising 0.85 °C/min) and Lube pressure is ALARM (3.88 bar, baseline 4.20, -6.4σ, falling 0.06 bar/min).
Sensor: SENSOR SIGNATURE best matches §5.3 p.32 Troubleshooting — lubrication system, which the manual links to §4.3 p.18. The sensor signature suggests discoloration ('color' defect type).

Manual §4.3 p.18: Describes discoloration (brown, blue or dark staining) as a cosmetic reject, caused by lubricant degradation (oxidised or water-contaminated forming oil), overheated die, or residue from a dirty quench/wash stage. It further states: 'Discoloured parts are cosmetic rejects but may also indicate reduced corrosion protection. Discoloration with die temperature above 64 °C and lube pressure below 4.05 bar indicates lubrication system fault — see section 5.3.'

alternative_causes.why_less_likely: No visual evidence of scratches is clearly dominant, and sensor readings point strongly towards lubrication issues.
No clear warping or folding is evident in the image.

work_order.title: Inspect and Address Lubrication System Anomaly on M10 Hex Nut (Line 3)
steps: 1. Stop the press at top dead centre and apply LOTO (Section 1, §1 p.3).
2. Check reservoir level and oil appearance. Take a 100 ml sample for water content (limit 0.1%) (Section 5.3 p.32).
3. Check differential pressure across filter F-7. Replace if > 0.8 bar (Section 5.3 p.32).
4. If oil is contaminated, drain reservoir, wipe sump, refill with FO-46, and bleed pump (Section 6.3 p.50).
5. Restart the press and confirm Lube pressure (PT-104) is at 4.2 ± 0.1 bar and Die temperature (TT-103) is below 64 °C within 15 minutes (Section 6.3 p.50).
safety: Verify zero energy by attempting a jog start before intervention.

containment: Quarantine all parts produced since the last good inspection (red bin, tag QH) (Section 7 p.58).
Record lot number, defect type (color), and suspected cause (lubrication fault) in the shift log (Section 7 p.58).
diagnosis.operator_message_en: Discoloration detected, likely due to lubrication system issues. Check oil condition and filter status.
diagnosis.operator_message_it: Rilevato scolorimento, probabilmente dovuto a problemi al sistema di lubrificazione. Controllare la condizione dell'olio e lo stato del filtro.
